newsitem.title: JAPAN: Southern Japan oil refinery undisturbed by quake.
newsitem.headline: Southern Japan oil refinery undisturbed by quake.

text.p: Kyushu Oil Co Ltd said operations at its Oita plant were not affected by a strong earthquake which hit Japan's southern island of Kyushu on Tuesday.
"Our plant has not been disturbed by the quake. Everything is working normally," a Kyushu Oil spokesman said.
The earthquake registered 6.1 on the Richter scale and was centred near the city of Sendai in Kagoshima Prefecture on the southwestern part of the island, the Meteorological Agency said.
The Oita plant, 215 km (134 miles) northeast of Sendai, is the sole oil refinery on the island.
The plant has a crude processing capacity of 136,000 barrels-per-day.
